title: Detection of the DNA binding of transcription factors in situ at the single-cell resolution in cultured cells by proximity ligation assay
protocol: Seed 5×10^3 Hsf1 wild type (Hsf1WT) or conditional knockout (Hsf1CKO) MEFs per well in a 96-well glass-bottom microplate in 100 μL of complete DMEM.
Allow the cells to grow for 24 h at 37°C in a CO2 cell culture incubator.
Replace complete culture media with serum-free media for 12 h.
Stimulate serum-starved cells by adding media supplemented with 20% serum for 24 h.
For the control, serum-starve cells for 12 h without subsequent serum stimulation.
Treat cells with 20 μM MYCi361 for 24 h to block c-Myc DNA binding.
For the control, treat cells with DMSO.
Culture cells at 45°C for 30 min to induce HSF1 DNA binding.
For the control, culture cells at 37°C.
Aspirate the media from the wells of the 96-well glass-bottom microplate.
Rinse the cells once with 150 μL 1X DPBS.
Add 100 μL of the fixation solution in each well.
Incubate for 10–15 min at 20°C–22°C.
Aspirate the fixation solution using a vacuum pump or micropipette.
Rinse once with 150 μL 1X DPBS.
Add 100 μL of the permeabilization buffer in each well.
Incubate for 10 min at 20°C–22°C.
Discard the permeabilization solution using a vacuum pump or micropipette.
Rinse once with 150 μL 1X DPBS.
Add 50 μL of the blocking solution provided with the Duolink In Situ PLA probe kits.
Incubate the samples in a 37°C humidified incubator for 30 min.
Dilute the primary antibodies to optimized concentrations in antibody dilution buffer provided with Duolink In Situ PLA probe kits.
Incubate cells with diluted primary antibodies on a slow laboratory rocker at 4°C for 12–16 hours.
Discard primary antibodies from the wells.
Wash cells with 150 μL of Wash Buffer A for 5 minutes on a slow laboratory rocker at 20°C–22°C.
Repeat washing step twice for 2 minutes each.
Dilute 5X Duolink In Situ PLA anti-Rabbit PLUS and 5X Duolink In Situ PLA anti-Mouse MINUS probes in the 1X antibody diluent to make a 1X working probe dilution.
Discard Wash Buffer A from the wells using a micropipette.
Add 40 μL of diluted PLA probes to each well, ensuring full coverage of the entire sample.
Incubate plate for 1 hour at 37°C in a humidified incubator.
Wash cells by adding 100 μL of Wash Buffer A on a slow laboratory rocker at 20°C–22°C for 5 minutes.
Repeat washing step twice for 2 minutes each.
Dilute the 5X Ligation Buffer to a 1X working solution using purified molecular biology grade water.
Thaw and resolve the DNA Ligase on ice before use.
Add 1 μL of DNA Ligase per 39 μL of 1X Ligation buffer to prepare the ligation reaction mix.
Incubate the plate at 37°C for 30 min in a humidified incubator.
Discard the ligation reaction mix from each well.
Wash cells by adding 100 μL of Wash Buffer A on a slow laboratory rocker for 5 min at 20°C–22°C.
Repeat the washing step twice for 2 min each.
Dilute the 5X Amplification Buffer to a 1X working solution using purified molecular biology grade water.
Add 0.5 μL of DNA polymerase to prepare the amplification reaction mix in 39.5 μL of 1X Amplification buffer.
Thaw and resolve the amplification buffer fully before dilution.
Store DNA polymerase at -20°C freezer, remove just before use.
Aliquot DNA polymerase to avoid repeated freeze/thaw cycles.
Add 40 μL of reaction mix to each well.
Incubate plate for 100–120 min at 37°C in a humidified incubator.
Cover and protect samples from light during amplification.
Discard the amplification reaction mix from wells.
Wash cells by adding 100 μL of 1X Wash Buffer B on a slow laboratory rocker for 5 min at 20°C–22°C.
Wash cells two more times using 0.01X Wash Buffer B for 2 min each.
Prepare 2 μM Hoechst 33342 solution in molecular biology grade water for nuclear staining.
Add 100 μL of nuclear staining solution in each well.
Incubate on a slow laboratory rocker for 5 min at 20°C–22°C.
Discard the nuclear staining solution.
Wash cells twice with molecular biology grade water for 2 min each on a slow laboratory rocker at 20°C–22°C.
Air dry the cells for 2 min at 20°C–22°C.
Add 60 μL of Fluoromount-G mounting medium to each well.
Mark wells on the reverse side of glass slides using a marker before removing chamber in multi-well chambers setup.
Add a coverslip to the slide and avoid air bubbles.
Seal edges of the coverslip using clear nail polish if using a mounting medium with DAPI.
Use IgG control samples to adjust PMT settings for acquiring images.
Acquire images using the DAPI channel at 405 nm for nuclear staining.
Acquire images using the Texas Red channel at 561 nm for PLA red signal.
Follow proper instructions for operating the confocal microscope.
Use immersion oil with the 63X lens and ensure the coverslip faces the lens.
